reviews.text: While my large dog loved the staff there I stopped taking him when I found out the staff weren't given any tips. Also a few  people at the dog park told me about negative interactions they had with the owner, leaving me with the decision to find daycare elsewhere.
My dog loves it there! If I ask him if he wants to go to daycare he gets so excited. Nora is always so cheerful in the mornings when we drop off.  He always comes home exhausted. Highly recommend

I love my dogs. It’s been a struggle to find a place that can accommodate their needs and who will care for them the way I do. RTW is down to earth, affordable and responsible. They speak dog here! I can tell they really care. I trust them with my puppy.
I texted them pictures of a building I was working on to let them know where the problem was. They got back to me promptly and politely letting me know I had the wrong number.

Ugh it pains me to write this review as I see the good work that Andrea and staff do at RTW but I thought to add my voice as I think there may be something to learn from my recent experience.

My dog was playing with another dog and things went sideways. Unfortunately, my dog got bit badly. It turned out to be an expensive vet bill. Okay, I accept that. It sucks but I understand there's some risk in having your dog play with others.

My issue after is that the other dog continues to be welcome at RTW. I don't feel comfortable having my dog return where the same incident may happen.

In addition, no refund was offered for the remaining full days I'd purchased in advance. I feel like an apology and some follow-up action (ie removing the other dog and/or offering a partial refund) would have sat better with me as a client.

At the same time, this is the first negative experience in the 7 months of care at RTW. But, unfortunately, this incident was enough to have us stop going. 😔

We left our little fur baby with Raise the Woof while on vacation recently. They were really great! We enjoyed our vacation without one worry. Lots of videos and photos was really helpful too. We would definitely use them again and recommend this business. Couldn't have wished for better care givers!

I would just love to say that I am in love as a doggo owner. 🥰🥰 The attention and care is just so attentive and love the feedback in what I can do better in helping with Biggie’s separation anxiety. Clean, friendly, great rates and a brewery right Nextdoor. 😜 …

I absolutely love this place. I have a high maintenance pain in my ass (husky, you get it) and this is the only daycare we've been to in the surrounding area that is up to the challenge. She always comes home happy, fed and tired. The staff is fantastic and the prices are super reasonable. Highly highly recommend.
Thank you for all the stars   :)
We love the place, our pup loves the place! So happy to have them near us.

Raise the woof is fantastic.  Every time we drop our dog off here he absolutely loves it. The staff is always amazing and super friendly.  For the price and convenience this place is the beet doggy daycare. Definitely recommend

I was recommended by a friend when I needed another daycare for my Frenchie, mainly for boarding services. We had a tour of the facility and it was a thorough introduction. Luna seemed to be right at home! RTW is very organized and because of the meet and greet before the trial day and online booking (to control capacity), we knew it was a major difference from the first daycare we went to (random drop offs = overcrowded with dogs). Vaccinations are reviewed online by the staff, and you cannot book until it is renewed- this ensures that all the furry friends are up to date with the vaccinations! For pick up, I love that they can see you come in from the camera, and once they come out, they already have your little one as well! I've been disappointed with previous experiences where I'd be asked every single time for my dog's name and then be given the wrong leash on multiple occasions, so I very much appreciate RTW's convenient routine. I also love that boarding services are right there at the facility for familiarity. I also want to point out that Luna smells great after a daycare session. Her paws don't smell like urine and she'll only require a wipe down over a rinse! I do want to mention that the front of the facility has a long set of stairs, but you could come to the back and walk down the driveway to the door that connects you to the reception. RTW is quite active on their IG and you can spy on your dog from there! I highly recommend RTW and I feel a great relief that I've found a trusted place to care for my baby when we are out of town! Thank you to the RTW team for all that you do! :)

I took my dog here when I needed another option for her while I was at work. She was only there for a short time as sadly she passed away, but my impression is that this business is run by people that truly care about the dogs they look after. They took the time to do a gentle introduction to daycare with my dog (with me present which I liked), patiently answered my many questions and concerns, and from what I saw were very good with my dog. I also appreciated the countless photos and videos they post on instagram, relieved my anxiety about how my dog was doing and also very cute to see. I was pretty particular about who I left my dog with, and I liked this place/trusted them.
Andrea and company are the best!
Been taking my pup Bones for almost a year to date and he has done daily daycare and boarding at times and loves the staff and other dogs in their care. Highly recommend.

Our duo it love it. They are so excited to go to daycare whenever I mention daycare to them. They spend the day hanging out with their friends and napping. Andrea has an amazing team! They are aware of our breed and ensure they are not …

Andrea and all her staff are great and all of them genuinely care about my dogs health and well being. My dogs come back relaxed, happy and tired. Its so nice to have a place to drop my dogs when life gets a bit overwhelming, and know that everyone is going to be happy.
